goal.raw_text: To allow the User to modify and adapt the application’s functions and parameters to the User’s needs and preferences through the settings menu.

claims.content: User
All pre-mentioned functions’ parameters can be modified and adapted to user’s needs and preferences from a settings’ menu.
The PeaZip application provides a “Settings” window titled “Set application’s default parameters.”

By pressing the “Options” button in the initial window of the application (file manager interface), a submenu appears with choices that have to do with settings of parameters of PeaZip’s features, according to users’ preferences.

trigger.raw_text: By pressing the “Options” button in the initial window of the application (file manager interface), a submenu appears with choices that have to do with settings of parameters of PeaZip’s features, according to users’ preferences.

claims.content: The User connects to the Settings Interface via the File Manager Interface.

The Settings Interface presents the Settings window, with the heading “Settings” and the subtitle “Set application’s default parameters”; the tabs shown include General (1), General (2), Create archive, Open archive, Open with..., File tools, and Theming, with “General (1)” currently selected.
The User modifies and adapts application functions and parameters to the User’s needs and preferences through the settings menu.
The application’s default parameters have been set.
The application’s functions have been modified and adapted to users’ preferences through a settings menu.
The functions’ parameters have been modified and adapted to the user’s needs and preferences from a settings’ menu.
PeaZip’s feature parameters have been set according to users’ preferences.
